Complaint to Cyber Bureau, Nepal Police
श्रीमान् प्रमुख ज्यू,
साइबर ब्यूरो, नेपाल प्रहरी, काठमाडौं।
विषय: खल्ती KYC ठगी सम्बन्धमा उजुरी।
I, Bikash Thapa (+9779856770011), received an SMS on 2026-08-02
warning that my Khalti account would be suspended unless KYC was completed.
I was directed to http://khalti-kyc-verify.top/login and paid a verification fee of
NPR 750 to Khalti ID 9812345678 (transaction KHL-2026-0802-44190). I was then
instructed to transfer NPR 9,500 to bank account 01903015472901.
The same helpdesk number +9779812345678 and email reward.center2026@gmail.com were used
throughout. I was also sent a second link,
https://esewa-bonus-claim.xyz/verify?ref=KYC2026, when I hesitated.
I request investigation and recovery of NPR 10,250.
